title: South Dakota Codified Laws Chapter 61-6 - Reemployment Assistance Benefits
verified_how: fetched the Title index https://sdlegislature.gov/api/Statutes/Statute/61: CatchLine 'REEMPLOYMENT ASSISTANCE', chapter row '06 Reemployment Assistance Benefits' with no [Repealed] marker; then fetched https://sdlegislature.gov/api/Statutes/Statute/61-6: Type 'Chapter', CatchLine 'REEMPLOYMENT ASSISTANCE BENEFITS', Repealed false, sections 61-6-1 to 61-6-68. Currency: code effective date 2026-09-03.
notes: South Dakota's name for unemployment insurance. Benefit entitlement, eligibility and disqualification - the most rule-dense everyday benefit statute in the Codified Laws; the claims machinery is ch. 61-7 (Claims Administration). Means-tested public assistance is a different Title: SDCL tit. 28 (Public Welfare and Assistance), principally ch. 28-7A (Temporary Assistance for Needy Families) and ch. 28-12 (Food Stamp Program), both verified in force on https://sdlegislature.gov/api/Statutes/Statute/28 (where ch. 28-2, 28-3, 28-4 and 28-7 are marked [Repealed] or [Repealed And Transferred]), but not listed because only one statute per topic is recorded.
